rows.title: General Updates
rows.summary: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)Regulations, 2015 read with the SEBI Master Circular No. SEBI/HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFDPOD2/I/3762/2026 dated January 30, 2026, as amended, this is to inform that Crisil ESG Ratings &Analytics Ltd ( the Rating Agency ), a SEBI registered Category I - ESG Rating Provider, hasindependently assigned rating of  Crisil ESG 69  to the Company for the year 2026. The overall ESG rating of the Company improved to  CRISIL ESG 69  from earlier rating of  CRISIL ESG 61 , as assigned for the year 2025. This ESG rating score reflects the Company s performance on Environmental, Social and Governance parameters as assessed by the Rating Agency.Please be informed that the Company did not engage the Rating Agency for the evaluation or issuance of its ESG Rating. The said report was prepared independently using publicly available information.The Company has received the said report by email on September 01, 2026, at 9:14 pm IST and the disclosure is made accordingly.
